raw_segments.text: No man prefers to sleep, too, in a bed. In fact, you would a good deal rather not sleep with your own brother.
I don't know how it is, but people like to be private when they are sleeping.
And when it comes to sleeping with an unknown stranger, in a strange inn, in a strange town, and that stranger a harpoonier,
Nor was there any earthly reason why I as a sailor should sleep, too, in a bed, more than anybody else.
For sailors, no more sleep, too, in a bed at sea than bachelor kings do ashore.
To be sure, they all sleep together in one apartment,
but you have your own hammock and cover yourself with your own blanket and sleep in your own skin.
